summary_en: eSOL will cancel all treasury shares held as of January 5, 2027, comprising approximately 285,142 shares including 4,862 restricted shares to be acquired for free on the cancellation date. Cancellation is conditional on shareholder approval of a stock consolidation effective January 6, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: eSOL Co., Ltd. announced on November 12, 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel all treasury shares held by the company. The cancellation, to be executed on January 5, 2027, will include approximately 285,142 shares: 280,280 shares held as of October 27, 2026, plus 4,862 restricted shares scheduled to be acquired for free on the cancellation date. These shares represent approximately 1.4% of total issued shares (calculated as 285,142 divided by 20,000,000 issued shares including treasury shares, adjusted for treasury share exclusion in the standard calculation base). The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval of a stock consolidation scheduled to take effect on January 6, 2027, which will be voted on at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting planned for December 10, 2026.
